entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order I received a few weeks ago. I'd like to see if I can return the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Ray, and the order number is VF7781-B. I should also mention I'm a VIP member, if that helps.

Thank you, Alex. I see your account here, and yes, I see your VIP status. Thanks for being a loyal VeloFit customer. I see the VeloBand was delivered 25 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's really just a preference. To be honest, I just changed my mind about needing it. It was a bit of an impulse buy during the holidays, and I've realized I just don't use it.
I understand completely. Thank you for clarifying that for me. Let me just check the return eligibility based on your purchase date. One moment.
Okay, Alex, I've got good news. I've just checked our policy, and I see that your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's fantastic. I was looking online and thought it might be more complicated. I appreciate you making that so easy.

It's my pleasure, especially for one of our VIP members. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see the refund back to your card within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've been a great help, Charlie. Thanks again.
You are very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
